content: The INLINEFORM0 value is based on the Kullback–Leibler divergence (KL divergence) between the probability distribution of the primary INLINEFORM1 output and those of two auxiliary modules, INLINEFORM2 and INLINEFORM3 , where INLINEFORM4 . The KL divergence at each timestep is averaged when the timesteps are dropped timesteps D, which is described in Section UID25 . The details of the primary and auxiliary prediction modules, which are used in the INLINEFORM5 calculation, are described in the following subsections.
